name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters II: Dark Duel Stories Game Guide 2 promotional card

printings.name: Left Arm of the Forbidden One

notes: Single-card promo ("Left Arm of the Forbidden One") bundled with the second DM2 strategy guide book (Shueisha, ISBN 4-08-779032-0). CORRECTION (2026-08 recertification, superseding two prior incorrect notes): a prior pass dated this 1999-08-05, again apparently copying the unrelated video-game-bundled product's chronology rather than this book's own date; an even earlier pass's chronology had referenced a "V-Jump Books DM2 promo" dated 1999-07-13, which a subsequent pass could not locate and treated as a phantom entry - it was not a phantom, it was this exact promo, just misdated in that pass's own working notes as well (1999-07-13 is actually the correct date of the sibling Game Guide 1 promo, not this one; the two are easy to conflate since both are DM2 guide-book bonus cards). Independently re-verified directly against Konami's official card-level print-history for this exact card (passcode 7902349): its sole 1999 printing entry is dated 1999-08-10 - re-confirmed live on 2026-08-28 (no 1999-08-05 entry exists anywhere on that page). Corroborated by Konami's own product-catalogue listing page (distinct "books" category, separate from the game-bundled promo) and by independent Japanese publisher (openBD/National Diet Library) metadata for the ISBN, which places publication in August 1999 (month-level, consistent with the day-level Konami date). Status upgraded reported -> verified: 2+ independent official channels now agree. Pool impact: none - 1999-08-10 remains well before the 1999-08-25 cutoff, same as the prior, incorrect date.
